general_information.Description: This is Skillful Reading 4 course, extracted from Skillful reading and writing 4 and intended to use for Upper-intermediate students. After the course, students can be able to use reading techniques (previewing, scanning, skimming, etc.) to comprehend reading passages related to academic topics such as psychology, Sociology, Biology, Chemistry, Business Studies.
general_information.StudentTasks: - Attend more than 80% of contact hours in order to be accepted to the final examination - Actively participate in class activities - Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class - Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose - Read the textbook in advance - Access the course website (www.cms.fpt.edu.vn) for up-to-date information and material of the course, for online supports from teachers and other students and for practicing and assessment.

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Identify the writer's position and identifying reasons and evidence of an argument
Identify and express contrasts; identify references to things outside the text
Understand analogies in a text and identify sources of information
Assess whether research supports an argument
Identify different perspectives and recognize trends and patterns
Use headings to understand the main ideas and identify fact, speculation and opinion
Identify persuasion techniques and assess the logic of an argument
Identify concepts and theories and inferring criticism
Identify logical fallacies and express causality

assessments.CLO: LO1, LO2, LO3, LO7, LO8, LO9
assessments.Question Type: Multiple choice, short answer questions, embedded questions
assessments.Knowledge and Skill: Test the acquainted knowledge which student obtained in the delivered units
assessments.Grading Guide: Paper test sheets/ Tests on cms
assessments.Note: Teacher is allowed to select which units content (topic or learning outcome) to focus on each examination session.

assessments.CLO: LO1, LO2, LO3, LO4, LO5, LO6, LO7, LO8, LO9, LO10
assessments.Question Type: Each student chooses one book/novel in English (supposed to be a masterpiece in English) to read and write a report following the format provided by teacher.
assessments.No Question: Following the format of book report provided by the teacher.
assessments.Knowledge and Skill: The whole report is about 500 words long.
assessments.Note: Teachers give topics, start and finish time for each Project/Assignment by themself.
